entities_involved.specific_connection_to_film: The arrangements of the song were by Luis Bacalov, a film composer. The lyrics were written by Lina Wertmüller, a director and screenwriter who directed the film 'Rita the Mosquito'.
He is an Argentine-born Italian composer of film scores, composed scores for Spaghetti Western films, and won an Academy Award for Original Score for 'Il Postino'.
